# @0xray/blip

Product mill for **4.44s shorties that blip** (picture + stereo bed). Desk: [blips.rippel.ai](https://blips.rippel.ai). Not the 0xRay OS suit.

```bash
npx @0xray/blip render --brief "night alley" --mode motion:orb
npx @0xray/blip render --brief "night alley" --mode motion:destination
npx @0xray/blip inspect
npx @0xray/blip vibe
npx @0xray/blip look
npx @0xray/blip replay
npx @0xray/blip sound render --brief "factory floor"
npx @0xray/blip sound taste
npx @0xray/blip sound voice
```

0xRay foundry keeps **fasten + inspect**. This package is the drawers. Railway `blip-plant` consumes it — no hand-vendored `foundry/*.cjs`.

`npx @0xray/foundry blip` shims here.

## Fasten

Protocol **foundry-plant/0**. Foundry fastens what this mill declares — prefix `blip` + `blip-*`, `sound` + `sound-*`. Named organs fasten because they are named, not because they sit in an xray catalog.

`foundry.json`:

```json
{ "plant": "@0xray/blip" }
```

or the alias `"plant": "blip"`. Default plant is `blip`. Both plants `millOff`. Drawers stay in `plant/skills` and `plant/agents`.
